critical-bundle-gzip.reason: SPEC §21.1: M13 measures 741,471 bytes gzip against the 350 KB budget after wasm-opt. The required critical path contains the editor/CRDT WASM, M9 offline search codec, shell search and task panes, and M13 template plus daily/weekly/monthly calendar-note support. M13 adds 13,152 bytes over the prior 728,319-byte M9/M14 baseline. The uncommitted wasm-opt=false setting was removed: it inflated this same build to 770,740 bytes and contradicted SPEC §21.1. Remaining levers are a size-tuned WASM profile, wasm-opt -Oz, or splitting heavy crates out of the initial module. Tolerance stays 0%, so any further growth fails. Earlier baseline history remains in git rather than in this operational exception file.

keystroke-to-paint.reason: SPEC §21.4: the measurement is a double-requestAnimationFrame from keydown and therefore resolves to one 60 Hz frame. It still detects the regression the budget guards against: a keystroke taking multiple frames. Removing this exception requires a reliable sub-frame browser metric.

longest-task.reason: SPEC §21.1: the throttled mobile cold start has a 65 ms main-thread task against the 50 ms budget while instantiating WASM and mounting the editor. Desktop remains inside budget and is deliberately not excepted. Re-measure after reducing or splitting the initial WASM module.

graph-fps.reason: SPEC §21.2: the 10,000-node desktop graph measures 58.3 ms p95 under headless Chromium's SwiftShader software renderer; the throttled mobile graph stays inside budget at its 2,000-node cap. Geometry caching improved this from 91.6 ms. Remaining levers are label-pass culling, cached edge rendering, and indexed line buffers.
